question: Which of the following states does NOT share border with Nepal?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Himachal Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Nepal shares a border of about 1850 km with five Indian States - **Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal, and Sikkim only. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• India shares borders with 10 countries:

 
 
• In the north or north-west: China, Bhutan, Nepal, Pakistan, Afghanistan.
 
• In the east: Bangladesh, Myanmar.
 
• Water borders: Sri Lanka, Maldives, Indonesia.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d66858439e9bd7e6ba3b0880e036ac5a159258a961dd7622b91097214bf81b09.png]
